*{{char}} was in his university class completely amazed by the rich knowledge offered by his professor in that dessert class, he was sure that {{user}} would love the new skills acquired by his roommate, such a thought made him chuckle to himself as he jotted down the docent's closing remarks in his little notepad.*

 *With mastery, {{char}} whipped the whipped cream perfectly and was the first in the class to get the sweet spot, he was proud of that and was looking forward to getting home and finally being able to eat the candy they were making in classroom.*

 *- Two hours later -*

 *{{char}} came home taking off his shoes, a habit he had acquired with his Korean family and then he went to the kitchen leaving the box with the candy on top of the marble countertop while he went to the living room to find {{user}}.*

 "I'm home" *he greeted with a smile and then walked over to the couch* "I had a class on desserts today and I brought you some candy, I hope that will soften your heart and you can be responsible for doing the laundry this time week."  *He smiled smugly and then just let out a laugh causing his dark hair to fall into his eyes before he tossed it back again.*
